topic_text.status: what they are doing these days
topic_text.history: their journey so far in studies and experiences
topic_text.interests: what they enjoy, in or outside their studies
topic_text.family_social: the people around them, their family and friends, and how those people see the student's path
topic_text.values: what matters most to them when they choose
topic_text.strengths: what they have done well, or what others come to them for
topic_text.pressures: what makes their choices hard: expectations, money, time or comparison
topic_text.sure: how sure they feel about their direction, on a scale from 0 to 10
topic_text.goals: what they want and whose wish that direction is
topic_text.options: the fields and kinds of work they know, and beliefs they want to check
